thread.title: Apple (AAPL) PT Set at $228.00 by JPMorgan Chase & Co.

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) PT Set at $228.00 by JPMorgan Chase & Co.
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has been assigned a $228.00 price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. in a research note issued on Friday. The firm currently has a “buy” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. JPMorgan Chase & Co. ‘s price target indicates a potential upside of 49.86% from the stock’s current price.
Other analysts have also recently issued reports about the stock. Nomura reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, November 5th. Robert W. Baird reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $235.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, September 24th. Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, October 22nd. Goldman Sachs Group reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $182.00 target price (down from $209.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, November 20th. Finally, Rosenblatt Securities set a $165.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “hold” rating in a research note on Thursday, December 20th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have given a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.19.
